_readme: Config for paper-trading/scripts/refresh.py (the daily engine). Edit the composite_universe / weights / tier maps here rather than in code. Keep symbols/slugs in sync with portfolio/FINAL_PORTFOLIO_RECOMMENDATION.md when the recommendation adds a name. (2026-09-05 folder reorg: this project now lives at projects/paper-trading/, siblings at projects/valuepickr-open-screen/ and projects/legacy-108-screen/; the cross-project merged docs moved from docs/ to a top-level portfolio/.)
_composite_v2_note: 2026-09-05: replaced the 4-factor (gap/conviction/fundamental/technical) composite with a 2-factor one (master/technical). master_score (valuepickr-open-screen/scripts/MASTER_SCORE_METHODOLOGY.md) already IS conviction+quality+gap+consistency+asymmetry renormalized -- keeping gap/conviction/fundamental as separate weighted composite inputs alongside it would double-count them. They're still computed and shown in the dashboard for context, just no longer weighted into `composite`. Technical is now itself weekly+monthly (technical_weights below).
_technical_thin_fading_note: 2026-09-26: Dynamic Cables / Venus Remedies post-mortem. Dynamic Cables sat at just +1.3%/+1.7% vs its 30W EMA for weeks -- inside the ext_cushion_knee_pct zone, so the OLD formula scored it full marks (100 base) right up until the week it broke below the EMA and got hard-excluded; there was no score-level distinction between a razor-thin cushion and a comfortable one. Venus Remedies's ext_pct visibly decayed (+24.9% -> +17.8% -> +10.6% over three straight weekly reads) while still comfortably positive, so the overextended_pct/knee mechanics never touched it either. 'thin_cushion_pct' now discounts the score for ext_pct between 0 and that threshold (scaled down toward 0 as ext_pct approaches 0, full marks restored at the threshold); 'fading_alert_pct'/'fading_penalty' subtract a fixed penalty when accel_pct (from flags.velocity_lookback_weeks/_months) is at or below that (negative) threshold, i.e. the cushion has been shrinking, not just being thin right now. Both apply to the actual technical score (affects composite ranking + next Monday's picks), not just the advisory flags below.
_technical_monthly_note: Softer, wider thresholds than weekly on purpose -- a 10-month EMA is a slower regime filter (Faber/GTAA-style), not a trade trigger. Never disqualifies from the pool the way a weekly EMA break does; only shifts the blended technical score. base_floor here is a genuine minimum score, not a gate.
_flags_note: 2026-09-26: advisory-only early-warning flags for the composite table (Novartis India post-mortem -- it peaked 2026-09-10 and rolled over ~19% while its weekly-close-gated Ext/Tech score didn't catch up until the following Monday). None of these gate the pool -- the weekly ext_pct<=0 hard gate in weekly_technical() remains the only exclusion rule. 'high_lookback_weeks' uses completed weekly bars (genuine 52-week high, unlike swing_screen.py's ~3-month daily-window max). 'ema_fast_*' mirrors swing_screen.py's daily 50-day EMA (faster than the 30-week EMA) for an earlier trend-break read. 'velocity_*' flags a blow-off in progress: how many points ext_pct (vs 30W EMA) has gained in the trailing lookback window, independent of its absolute level.
